title: Customized Tampa Heights Private Brewery Tour by Golf Cart
includes: Stop at your selection of Murals and Landmarks for pictures
Tour between your choice of up to five Breweries
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
21 Years old is the minimum age for this tour
Digital Consent forms for all adults will be sent by text or Viator messaging app. Rider consent forms will need to be completed before the tour can start.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: By booking our tour, up to five guests are provided pickup, drop off and transportation between up to five breweries. There are five breweries in The Heights pre-selected, but riders have the option to modify their trip from a full list of locations. All riders must be 21 years of age or older. This tour lasts 2.5 hours including pick up and drop off. This tour provides the transportation in a fun and unique way to see the City of Tampa and visit your choice of breweries.
